title: chore: serve all legacy image cache misses from the worker
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Raised the legacy image API’s cache Worker share from 50% to 100%, routing every cache miss and `/feed` through the Worker while retaining the unused VM as a fallback. The Worker’s FeedHub preserves `/feed` events, replay, and filtering while keeping API keys out of `imageURL`. At 50% traffic, the Worker had no exceptions across roughly 26,000 requests in 15 minutes; observed 500s had the same underlying causes on both paths. Gen’s image-bridge-key 429s reflect an existing per-key cap also reached by the VM.
